verdict.rationale: Jan documents an OpenAI-compatible local API server with GET /v1/models and chat completions, and model import from GGUF files or Hugging Face IDs. Nothing in the evidence shows a way to assign a custom alias or identifier to a loaded model for use in API calls. Searching the Hub by Hugging Face ID and configuring the API prefix are adjacent features, not model aliasing.

support.subject: As a developer, I can assign a custom identifier to a loaded model for consistent reference in API calls
